notes:
Security and reliability release.

TLS verification now fails closed — a server certificate that doesn't chain to the CA in your kubeconfig is refused instead of trusted. Updates are verified against a published SHA-256 before anything is mounted or installed. Secret values are masked by default, copied to a concealed clipboard that self-clears, and saved as a single atomic merge-patch conditional on resourceVersion. Client-certificate auth works again (cert chains and EC keys) with no keychain prompts. Pods stay live via a watch stream instead of polling. Universal binary for Intel and Apple Silicon. 137 tests and CI, from zero.
